newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-La Tondena rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-La Tondena rated a buy.

text.p: Asian Capital Equities Inc recommended on Friday a buy on liquor producer La Tondena Distillers Inc saying the firm had strong 1997 earnings prospects.
Asian Capital predicted La Tondena's net income to reach 1.44 billion next year, substantially higher than the projected 731 million pesos for this year.
The company reported a net income of 389 million pesos, stripped of extraordinary gains, in the first nine months of the year.
Analyst Bernardita Bautista said she expected a fourth quarter surge in orders, especially for its flagship product Ginebra gin.
At the same time, Bautista said, declining molasses prices in the coming months could widen profit margin.

"Aside from higher revenues and wider margins, the new carbon dioxide project may bring in some 200 million pesos next year. If this pushes through as scheduled, 1997 forecasts may even reach 1.44 billion pesos," she said.
La Tondena, a unit of San Miguel Corp, dropped 50 centavos to 59.50 pesos by midsession Friday.
